+## What
+
+marketplace.md §9.2 and §9.3. Marketplace control is a host and CLI function. It is **not** a model operation: the fused `SkillsTool` gets no new operation.
+
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/CLI/MarketplaceCLI.swift`: an ArgumentParser `AsyncParsableCommand` named `marketplace` (ArgumentParser comes through the `Operations` re-export), with these subcommands:
+  - `list` — the sources in order, with id, URL, current SHA, catalog version, last checked, and status

+  - `update [<id>] [--force]`
+  - `pin <id> <sha>` and `unpin <id>`
+  - `add <url> [--ref <ref>] [--alias <alias>]` — append to the user `marketplaces.yaml` through `MarketplaceConfig.save`, so the new entry wins over earlier ones
+  - `remove <id>`

+- Errors go to standard error with a non-zero exit code.
+- `Examples/skills-demo/SkillsDemoMain.swift`: add a `--marketplace` mode that passes the remaining arguments to `MarketplaceCLI`, with the demo's fixture stack as the config stack.
+
+- [ ] `MarketplaceCLI` command group and subcommands
+- [ ] Config loading with `--include-project`, and `add`/`remove` through `MarketplaceConfig.save`
+- [ ] The public way to add the group next to the existing driver
+- [ ] `skills-demo --marketplace`
+- [ ] Tests
+

+- [ ] `add`, `list`, `update`, `pin`, `unpin`, `check`, and `remove` work against a `file://` fixture repository and a temporary cache and config folder
+- [ ] The `SkillsTool` operation list is unchanged
+- [ ] `skills-demo --marketplace list` runs as a subprocess and exits with 0
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/MarketplaceCLITests.swift`: drive each subcommand with `GitFixtureRepository` over `file://`, `SKILLS_MARKETPLACE_CACHE` set to a temporary folder, and a temporary config stack; assert the output text and the file changes; an unknown id gives a non-zero exit; `--include-project` is required to read the project file
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/SkillsDemoTests.swift`: add a subprocess case for `--marketplace list`
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/SkillsToolAssemblyTests.swift`: assert that the operation names did not change
+- [ ] Run `swift test`; all green
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

+
+    Decisions:
+    - The CLI builds its `list` rows from the configured sources plus `state.json`, and it never prints a URL that did not parse. A URL with a credential in it cannot parse (`MarketplaceSourceError.credentialsInURL`), thus no credential can reach the output. `add` parses the URL before it writes, thus a credential never reaches `marketplaces.yaml` either.
+    - The group runs through `MarketplaceCLI.run(arguments:context:)`, which gives a `CLIResult` in the same shape as `OperationCLIDriver.run(arguments:)`. `SkillsCLI` gets one entry point that runs the group when the arguments name it, and `SkillsCLI.makeDriver(registry:)` does not change.
+    - A `MarketplaceCLIContext` carries the dotfolder stack and the environment, thus a test drives every subcommand over a temporary stack and a temporary cache.

+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m2kvv9f2t783bvv67bpmc4jt
+  text: |-
+    ### What landed
+
+    New files under `Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/CLI/`:
+    - `MarketplaceCLI.swift` — the `marketplace` group, an `AsyncParsableCommand`, with `list`, `check [<id>]`, `update [<id>] [--force]`, `pin <id> <sha>`, `unpin <id>`, `add <url> [--ref] [--alias]`, and `remove <id>`. `list`, `check`, `update`, `pin`, and `unpin` take `--include-project`.
+    - `MarketplaceCLIContext.swift` — the dotfolder stack and the environment. The cache folder comes from `MarketplaceCache.cacheDirectory(environment:)`.
+    - `MarketplaceCLISession.swift` — one run: the folders, the lines, and the helpers that load the configuration and make the store.
+    - `MarketplaceRow.swift` — what `list` shows for one marketplace.
+    - `MarketplaceCLITable.swift` — the column layout that `list` and `check` share.
+    - `MarketplaceCLIError.swift`, `MarketplaceCLIResult.swift`.
+
+    `SkillsCLI` gets `marketplaceCommandName` and `runMarketplace(arguments:context:)`, which runs the group when the first argument names it and gives `nil` otherwise. `SkillsCLI.makeDriver(registry:)` did not change.
+
+    ### Decisions and their reasons
+
+    - **A result type of our own.** `OperationsCLI.CLIResult` has an `internal` initializer, thus this package cannot make one. `MarketplaceCLIResult` has the same two fields, and the doc comment says so.
+    - **No credential can reach the output.** `add` parses the URL before it writes, and a URL with a credential in it is no §5.1 form, thus `MarketplaceSourceError.credentialsInURL` stops it. `list` shows the normalized URL of a source that parses, and no URL at all for a source that does not. A case proves that the refusal message does not hold the token.
+    - **`list` reads only the disk.** The store has no accessor for the URL, the catalog version, and the last check together, and `marketplaceLayers()` carries the `url` field as the host wrote it. The rows thus come from the configured sources plus `state.json`, over the same `MarketplaceIdentity` helpers that the store uses. `check`, `update`, `pin`, and `unpin` build a `MarketplaceStore` as the card says.
+    - **The error text goes back to the host.** The package cannot print: `print` is a forbidden construct. The run gives the text and a non-zero exit code, in the same shape as `OperationCLIDriver.run(arguments:)`, and the doc says the host writes a non-zero result to standard error. A subcommand that a host runs inside its own command tree finds no session and writes to standard output through `FileHandle`.
+    - **`check` and `update` with an unknown id.** `MarketplaceStore.check()` takes no id and `update(_:)` is silent about one, thus the command resolves the id to a row first and throws `MarketplacePinError.unknownMarketplace(id:)`. The exit code is then not zero.
+    - **`SkillsToolAssemblyTests`.** The case `theMarketplaceSourceTextLeavesTheOperationNamesAndParametersAlone` already asserts that the operation names and the parameter names do not change. It is still green, and a second copy of it would be duplication. Nothing was added there.
+
+    ### Evidence
+
+    - `swift build --build-tests`: no error and no warning.
+    - `swift test`: 696 tests in 53 suites passed. The new suite "Marketplace CLI" holds 18 cases.
+    - swiftlint over the gated rules (force unwrap, force try, force cast, unused optional binding, unowned capture, legacy constructor, function and closure body length, magic numbers) and over `missing_docs`: clean.
+    - swiftformat `--lint` over the 27 idiom rules: clean.
+  timestamp: 2026-09-16T01:03:38.978791+00:00
